reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:2bedcd69fb6a460a8bd2129b128a30b9]] The heat is perfect and the tools works great, it curled my eyelashes perfectly in less than 10 seconds! Comes with a charging cord but you will need a USB box to charge it. Also comes with an instruction sheet. It says the button will turn from green to blue but for me it just stays green, so I let it heat up for around 30 sec to 1 minute before use. It will automatically turn off after around 3 minutes.

I did a lot of research before settling on this curler. In the end it was a best seller and the reviews were great. It’s super easy to use. Has two heat settings and is easy to handle. It has a very natural curl that doesn’t kink my lashes like a traditional eyelash curler. My eyelashes stay curled even after wiping mascara off at the end of the day. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking to purchase.

Best eyelash curler I’ve owned. I have very short eyelashes and it really curled my lashes much better than the conventional eyelash curlers I’ve owned. I used the hottest setting and it did not cause any discomfort. Great packaging, charged up quickly & heats up fast. I’m very happy with my purchase.

I am a big fan of heated eyelash curlers. I have found that they always maintain the curl longer than traditional curlers. Being able to recharge rather than feeding it batteries is a BIG plus too. This model does what it says, curls my lashes and actually keeps them somewhat curled for a second day. It is not a tight curl, but looks very natural. There is a slight learning curve about where to place the curler so you don't pull your lashes or heat your eyelid. It shuts itself off pretty quickly

I’ve seen this eyelash curler everywhere and knew I had to try it out. At first, the heating sensation part of it can feel a little weird but once you get used to it,  I noticed my lashes were not only longer, but they stayed curled longer than using a regular eyelash curler. Takes some time getting used to it, but highly recommend.

I like that it's shaped like a traditional curler and the USB battery power is a really convenient function. It takes a little getting used to to get all your lashes in and then starting a safe distance so it's not to warm on your eyelids. But it seems to function the way its supposed to and it definitely helps my lashes stay up for much longer than my traditional curler. Would like it in a different color maybe but that's really not that important to me.

Amazing product! I bought this as a gift for my teenager who previously had a battery operated heated eyelash curler • which quit working in less than a year.  She loves that she is able to use a usb to charge this one and she says it’s much easier to use than previous curlers and it holds it charge for a long time! Highly recommend 😊

reviews.t: Curl lasts all day! Needs charged often
reviews.x: I have incredibly straight eyelashes that point downward. As a woman, I am self conscious about it, but I don't want crazy chemical perming stuff near my eyeballs nor do I have the money to do that regularly. Regular eyelash curlers only give a curl that lasts so long. This heated curler is IT for me. If I use this in the morning, the curl lasts all day! I bought this with my own money so not paid for this review. I've only had this a couple weeks do no telling what the durability is of the prod

First of all, I was little upset when I learned the shipping was delayed for extra few days but it came with a lot nicer package so it made the neutral start for the evaluation :)  Though it's made of plastic, and not like the traditional curler in steel, the quality and the material feels pretty good. Feels sturdy as well. I can easily imagine using this curler in next few years. As far as the functionality goes, Excellent. It heats up the pressing silicone really quick and the best of all, it

reviews.t: Finally, a heated eye lash curler that works!
reviews.x: I have tried 2 other models of heated eye last curlers and neither worked as advertised. This one is different!  It actually gets warm enough to do the job. My lashes stay curled longer than when I use my non-heated eyelash curler. They stay curled all day.  The shape of it allows me to get the lashes at the outer corner of my eyes, which are often left out with conventional eye lash curlers. Something about the less rounded shape allows me to go back and curl more without messing them up. When
I love it. After chemo I lost most of my lashes. With this  I can curl and actually use mascara for the first time in 4 years. Do yourself a favor and get one

I’ve tried regular eyelash curlers in the past but never got satisfactory results.  More recently, as a result of both my age and the effects of my cancer treatment medications, I’ve developed “hooded” eyes.  I’ve had to radically change how I apply my eye makeup for my eyes to show up at all.  To make my eyelashes visible (I did try false eyelashes but I’m a bit of a klutz and can’t get them on right) I bought this curler to hopefully make my eyelashe curl up and not just stick straight out.  I

This eyelash curler worked great.  I am so happy since I was looking for a product that would curl my eyelashes.  A while back, I tried heating my eyelash curler and wound up burning my eyelid (ouch)!  So, you can imagine how thrilled I was when I came across this product.  I have long eyelashes and after heating them, I could feel them on my eyelids.  So, that is proof that it worked really well!!  Oh, it got even better when I applied mascara.  I am one happy customer!

reviews.t: Keeps your eyelashes up and curled all day!!!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:c028a0e0f44ba0bf558c675e1dd24636]] I absolutely love this eyelash curler! Keeps your lashes curled and up all day! Usually withy regular eyelash curler my lashes will get straight throughout the day but not with this one!! The eyelash curler doesn't get too hot either, it gets warm and then has an auto shut off. And it comes with a charger! Love this! Perfect for those who have stubborn straight lashes like myself.

Regular eyelash curlers do not make my curl last more than an hour. I do two 20 second holds on each eye with this heat curler and the curl lasts all day. Obsessed! Also this will not burn your lids… I was afraid of that. Just feels warm. Much better than paying 200 to get them chemically lifted every 2 months. Highly recommend.
Forget the days when you gotta use a hairdryer to warm up your tradditional lash curler. This works like a charm!

I do not review many items, but I felt this item warranted a review.  I also waited a bit to write this review to see if ease of use improved after some practice.  I have been using an eyelash curler for my whole life.  I have long, straight, fairly thick lashes that don't like to hold a curl. I love the fact that this eyelash curler is heated.  It curls my lashes, and they stay curled much longer than if I used a non-heated curler.  That was actually the entire reason I purchased it.  However,

I had had another heated eyelash curler years ago, until it stopped working.  I have been without one since then, until I saw this for purchase at Amazon. It heats up quickly using a usb outlet.  It has 2 temperature settings.  I have found that the higher temperature setting works better for my 69 year old eyelashes.  It is easy to use - no learning curve. It is small enough to be able to pack for traveling. I am delighted that my eyelashes stayed curled all day. Thank you for a great product!

Updated Review: The customer service team reached out to me and offered me a full refund or product exchange to maker sure I was happy with the purchase. Although the product itself didn’t work as stated, I would recommend this seller and would purchase other items from them. Great customer service. Satisfaction is their goal!  Original Review: I was excited to receive this product however, doesn’t get warm or curls your lashes. My manual eyelash curler works better than this.

reviews.t: Natural curl! It doesn't pinch my eyelids!
reviews.x: I like this product. It heats up pretty fast, it doesn't pinch my eyelids and it gives natural curl that last all day. The temperature is hot enough to curl the lash but not at all uncomfortable. You don't have to squeeze very hard because of the heat. My eyelash is very straight because I'm an Asian so it's been difficult to curl the lashes and make them look natural without kink. Now I can have lashes that curls up. I'm very happy with this product.

reviews.t: VERY pleasantly surprised! It's not scary at all!
reviews.x: I was soooo hesitant to use a product like this. Heat near my eye was scary! BUT Now that I've actually tried it, with two different heat settings, it's a breeze, and it really did feel like my lashes had a better curl than with mascara alone, or even a boring eye lash curler. PLUS I got it in my favorite color! Such a bonus!  You will not regret this purchase, unless you love straight, boring lashes! Treat yo'self! It really works!

I have very straight eyelashes that point down and after using this eyelash curler, the lashes stay up all day! I only use the high heat option as the low heat option does not yield as great results. I would advise first time users to be careful not to clip the top eyelid when using this product. I clipped a bit of my eyelid the first time I used it but it has not happened again.

The electric curlers are hard to use on short lashes and it takes a lot of practice to get good at it! This takes the place of heating your eye lash curler with a blow dryer and potentially burning yourself and gives a nice constant temperature that is safe on eyes! Great product!

reviews.t: No Different then a Regular Eyelash curler
reviews.x: I curled one eye with a regular eyelash curler and the other with Sekalar heated eyelash curler. There was no difference. The company sent me a $15 gift cerificate if I gave it a 5-star review but I couldn't because the good reviews is what suckered me into buying it.

reviews.t: I’ll never use another eyelash curler
reviews.x: I have very long eyelashes but can never get them to hold a curl so it always ends up looking like I hardly have any. With this eyelash curler you can actually see that I have long eyelashes. It’s easy to use and keeps my eyelashes curled throughout the day.

claims.text: Reviewers say it curls lashes effectively and the curl lasts much longer than with traditional curlers, often all day.
Users find it easy to use and appreciate the fast heating and rechargeable USB power.
It gets warm but does not burn or cause discomfort, though the heating sensation takes some getting used to.
Some reviewers note it needs to be charged often.
It works well for people with short, straight, or sparse lashes, including after chemo or cancer treatment.

qa.q: Does it actually hold a curl all day?
qa.answer: Yes, multiple reviewers report the curl lasts all day [1][4][5][6], with one noting it stays curled even after wiping mascara off at day's end [3].

claims.text: Lashes stay curled even after wiping mascara off at the end of the day.

qa.q: How long does the battery last per charge?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it safe for my eyes and does it get too hot?
qa.answer: Reviews indicate it is safe and not too hot: users report the hottest setting caused no discomfort [2], the temperature is hot enough to curl but not uncomfortable [4], and it doesn't pinch eyelids [4]. One reviewer initially feared heat near the eye but found it a breeze with two heat settings [1].

claims.text: Using the hottest setting did not cause any discomfort.
The temperature is hot enough to curl the lash but not at all uncomfortable.
A reviewer who was initially scared of heat near the eye found it a breeze with two heat settings.

qa.q: How fast does it heat up?
qa.answer: Reviews describe it as heating up fast or quickly [1][2], with one reviewer letting it heat for around 30 seconds to 1 minute before use [3].

claims.text: It heats up quickly using a USB outlet.
One reviewer lets it heat up for around 30 seconds to 1 minute before use.

qa.q: Is it easy to use on short or stubborn lashes?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one reviewer says the electric curlers are hard to use on short lashes and take a lot of practice [2], while another calls it easy to use [5]. For stubborn straight lashes, one reviewer says it curls lashes that don't hold a curl [1] and another with very straight lashes says it gives a natural curl [6].

claims.text: The electric curlers are hard to use on short lashes and take a lot of practice.
It's easy to use and keeps eyelashes curled throughout the day.
It curls lashes that don't like to hold a curl.
For very straight lashes, it gives a natural curl that lasts all day.
